kpis: UC2-KPI-2, -5, -6, -8 (SPEC A3.8); outage sweep (SPEC A4 N1)
design: six inspections; coordinator crash at a seeded time (30-600 s), a robot failure during the outage, coordinator restart after outage_s (inf: never before the horizon); outcomes from the skill servers' records

detection.coordinator_loss: MQTT heartbeat timeout and last-will, through the edge broker
detection.robot_failure: MQTT last-will of the robot, through the edge broker

provenance.ul_capacity: measured TCP goodput of one device in the velodrome, 20 MHz (UPV)
provenance.coverage_calibration: RSRP/SINR read from UPV's velodrome plots (no CSV)
provenance.sinr: downlink SINR from the plots; uplink quality assumed to follow it
provenance.link_profiles_good_rtt: measured n40 one-way 9.76 DL + 8.89 UL ms (UPV)
provenance.other: Nexus n40 cell (Building 6G), LTE B7, n258 and n78 not modelled
